crimeSurvey.title: Crime experienced by households and individuals
crimeSurvey.sourceLabel: Crime Survey for England and Wales (CSEW)
crimeSurvey.summary: 9.6 million CSEW headline crime incidents were estimated in the latest survey, with no statistically significant annual change.
crimeSurvey.caveat: The CSEW is the preferred measure for long-term trends in common crimes. Estimates cover people aged 16 and over, exclude some populations and are subject to sampling uncertainty.

policeRecorded.title: Crimes recorded by the police
policeRecorded.sourceLabel: Home Office police recorded crime, published by ONS
policeRecorded.summary: Police recorded around 5.2 million crimes excluding fraud and computer misuse, 1% fewer than the previous year.
policeRecorded.caveat: Police-recorded crime is not the preferred measure for general crime trends because reporting, recording practices and police activity change. It is more useful for lower-volume, higher-harm offences. Recorded fraud and computer misuse are excluded while the new Report Fraud system is being introduced.

justice.title: Criminal court timeliness
justice.sourceLabel: Ministry of Justice Criminal court statistics quarterly
justice.summary: Median completion times increased in both magistrates’ courts and the Crown Court compared with the same quarter a year earlier.
justice.caveat: Court timeliness measures completed defendant cases and is backwards-looking. It must not be presented as a crime rate or combined with victimisation and recorded-offence totals.
